# Stanford Advanced Materials

> Global supplier of advanced fabricated products, machining parts, and specialty materials for aerospace, electronics, energy, and industrial applications.

Stanford Advanced Materials is a comprehensive materials supplier offering an extensive catalog of metals, ceramics, optical products, rare-earth magnets, and specialty compounds. The company serves industries including aerospace, semiconductor manufacturing, energy storage, and research laboratories with high-quality materials in various forms.

## Key Topics

- Advanced Materials
- Rare-earth Magnets
- Sputtering Targets
- 3D Printing Powder
- Tungsten
- Hyaluronic Acid
- Ceramic Materials
- Metal Injection Molding
- Aerospace & Automotive
- Semiconductor
- Energy Storage & Batteries
- Optical Products
- Composite Materials
- Laboratory Equipment
- Industrial Fasteners

- [Composites Products & Materials for Sale](https://www.samaterials.com/composites.html): Composite materials supplier for aerospace, automotive, and advanced applications.
- [Compounds Products & Materials for Sale](https://www.samaterials.com/compounds.html): Chemical compounds catalog featuring industrial compounds and research materials.

## Specialty Materials & Components

- [Rare-Earth Magnets Supplier](https://www.samaterials.com/213-rare-earth-magnets.html): Rare-earth magnets supplier offering permanent neodymium magnetic lifters and products.
- [Pure Hyaluronic Acid Powder for Sale](https://www.samaterials.com/hyaluronic-acid.html): Pure hyaluronic acid wholesale supplier offering medical, cosmetic, and food grade products.
- [Optical Products](https://www.samaterials.com/110-optical-products.html): Optical products including laser crystals, prisms, beam splitters, lenses, and windows.
- [Laboratory Equipment Product List](https://www.samaterials.com/13-laboratory-equipment.html): Laboratory equipment including zirconia and agate mortars, pestles, and lab supplies.
